spans.text: Digital content is anything that can be stored or sent digitally. This can include content such as text, audio, video files, graphics, animations and images.
A server is a computer that provides services on a network.
Servers can store many different types of digital content. Here are some examples:
Photographs and images are stored on servers. People can share pictures or photo albums with other people.

Servers are also responsible for storing and sending messages from one device to another over a network. Messages are mainly text-based but can include images and emojis too. Messenger apps are common on mobile devices.
Files and data for websites are stored on servers.
Email providers like Gmail, Hotmail and Yahoo! Mail store email messages on servers. Users can access their emails from computers and other devices connected to the internet.
Online software is stored on servers and used remotely by users. Software such as Google Docs™ allows users to create and edit documents, that are stored on Google’s servers.
All online games are stored on servers. Each game generally has its own server.
Video content is stored on servers and includes movies, TV shows and music videos.
Audio content is stored on servers and includes music, podcasts and audio books. Music is the most popular form of audio.
